title: Cuidez vous que Dieu nous faille (Richafort)
desc: Jean Richafort, Cuidez vous que Dieu nous faille. 5 voices (Superius I, Superius II, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
